GASt male ZT17: Deficient vs Control

selected.gene_filter: genes expressed if normalized average count >= 10; ~15,077 expressed per tissue (S4.3.13.p1)
selected.normalization: DESeq2 per tissue, females and males together (S4.3.12.p1)

decisions.reason: S4.3.13.p1: DESeq2 per tissue, contrasts by sex, energy deficiency and ZT, BH padj < 0.05, expressed = normalized mean >= 10. S2.3.p1/FIG3A: the main result is Deficient vs Control per tissue and sex irrespective of time of day; S2.4.p1/Table S5 adds ZT5- and ZT17-specific contrasts. S4.1.3.p1 deposits raw and normalized counts as GSE243060.

checks: series_id GSE243060 named in S4.1.3.p1 and TAB2 as this paper's deposit
contact van Rosmalen, Salk Institute (corresponding author Panda, Salk, S4.1.1.p1)

decisions.reason: The paper names GSE243060 as its own deposit of raw and normalized counts; GEO sample counts, tissues, factors and processing match the Methods.

selected.method: exact:raw_matrix_column (raw_matrix_column = GEO library name from 'description', with or without the R 'X' prefix, exact)

decisions.reason: All 24 Gastrocnemius tendon GSM samples match one raw-matrix column exactly (coverage 1.0). Library codes (sex, L/H workload, ZT) agree with the GEO characteristics for every sample; each mouse gives one sample in this tissue. Derived formula-safe columns: sex (F/M), trt (ctrl/def), zt (zt05/zt17), mouse, libstyle.

selected.provenance: STAR v2.7.10a gene counts (GEO data_processing: 'csv file includes raw counts for each sample'; file name raw_counts)

candidates: raw_counts (confirm against provenance: normalized integers and rounded estimated counts look the same)

selected.paper_input: raw counts into DESeq2, normalized per tissue (S4.3.12.p1, S4.3.13.p1)

decisions.reason: All values are non-negative integers with no missing values; GEO and the paper call the file raw STAR counts; the companion normalized file equals these counts divided by per-tissue median-of-ratios size factors, which confirms they are the counts the authors gave DESeq2.

selected.analysis_type: multi-factor (sex x treatment x ZT), between-animal, one DESeq2 model per tissue and analysis
selected.formula: model A: ~ cell (cell = sex x trt); model B: ~ cell (cell = sex x trt x zt)
selected.estimand_type: causal (randomized high vs low workload), estimand = exercise-linked energy deficiency vs low-workload exercise
selected.suitability_note: libstyle passed as a covariate candidate

decisions.reason: Randomized high vs low workload (S4.2.2.p1). Paper: DESeq2 per tissue, contrasts by sex, energy deficiency and ZT; main results per sex irrespective of ZT (FIG3A), plus ZT-specific contrasts (Table S5). Model A pools ZT; model B uses all 8 cells. Planned = Deficient vs Control within sex (A) and within sex x ZT (B); other comparisons from the suitability report are exploratory. Library-name style aliased with sex: False (sex main-effect comparisons dropped then).

covariates.name: mouse
covariates.disposition: excluded: one sample per mouse within a tissue (identifier, not a block)

covariates.name: zt
covariates.disposition: excluded from model A (paper pools ZT); a design factor in model B

covariates.name: libstyle
covariates.disposition: excluded: library-name format is only a proxy for sequencing run, not a stated batch, and the paper did not model it; vs trt: crossed; vs sex: crossed

covariates.name: estrous stage
covariates.disposition: excluded: not in GEO; paper notes control females mostly estrus, deficient mostly diestrus (S3.1.p1)

decisions.reason: Between-animal design within a tissue; no repeated measure. Both cell-means designs are full rank with positive residual df.

selected.gene_filter: keep genes whose mean deposited normalized count (per-tissue DESeq2 median-of-ratios) over the tissue's samples is >= 10 (S4.3.13.p1)

paper_route.status: reproduced with pydeseq2; formula not reported, interpreted as above
